notions.name: Becoming.Web.Widens
notions.grain: two level paths over a whole run (every step included, some step exceeded); of a part where one path is the levels without it
notions.quote: 07 section 2, r-four-cases-of-a-part: "`l` *widens* `l'` when it includes and exceeds it"; docstring Regions.lean:149: "The level path `l` widens `l'`"
notions.says: W.Includes l l' and W.Exceeds l l': l admits at every step every formation l' admits, and at some step one more.

notions.name: Becoming.«广»
notions.grain: on the grammar: any two relations on one carrier, no steps
notions.quote: docstring GrammarLaws.lean:2723: "`R` widens `S` (广): it relates whatever `S` relates and exceeds it"; chapter line 67 calls it "the grammar's widening, «广»"
notions.says: «则» S R and «逾» R S: R relates whatever S relates and relates some pair S does not.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensWithin
notions.grain: within a decided region of formations, over a whole run
notions.quote: docstring OwnWidening.lean:70: "Within the decided region `region`, the level path `l` widens `l'`"
notions.says: At every step l admits every member of the region l' admits, and at some step a member l' does not.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensAlong
notions.grain: along a reading of one web's formations in another's, over a whole run
notions.quote: 07 section 2, r-widening-along-a-reading: "`l'` widens `l` where it admits, read, every formation `l` admits ... (`Web.WidensAlong`)"; docstring: "**Widening along a reading**"
notions.says: IncludesAlong and ExceedsAlong: l' of W' admits the reading of all l admits, and at some step a formation that is the reading of none l admits.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensAcross
notions.grain: one level path over a stretch from step T to step U, along a continuation
notions.quote: docstring ContinuedClasses.lean:490: "**Widening across a stretch along a continuation**: inclusion and exceeding from `T` to `U`"
notions.says: IncludesAcross and ExceedsAcross from T to U: everything admitted at T is linked to something admitted at U, and something admitted at U is linked to nothing admitted at T.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.EventuallyWidens
notions.grain: from some step on, on every tail
notions.quote: 07 section 2, r-eventual-widening: "One level path *eventually widens* another where, from some step on, it widens it on every tail"; docstring: "**Eventual widening**"
notions.says: There is a T such that for every S at or after T the tail of l from S widens the tail of l' on the web from S.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensWithoutEnd
notions.grain: whole run, exceeding at arbitrarily late steps
notions.quote: docstring EventualWidening.lean:109: "**Widening without end**: `l` includes `l'` at every step and exceeds it at arbitrarily late steps"
notions.says: W.Includes l l' and W.ExceedsLate l l'.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensUpTo
notions.grain: over the stretch up to a step h
notions.quote: docstring EventualWidening.lean:114: "**Wider up to a step**: up to step `h`, `l` admits every formation `l'` admits, and at some step up to `h` one it does not"
notions.says: Inclusion at every step up to h and exceeding at some step up to h.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensOrEventually
notions.grain: whole run or late tails (a join of two listed notions)
notions.quote: docstring EventualWidening.lean:121: "Widening, or eventual widening."
notions.says: W.Widens l l' or W.EventuallyWidens l l'.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.KeepsWidening
notions.grain: one course (one level path), from a step T on, along a continuation R
notions.quote: 07 section 2, r-eventual-widening: "A course *keeps widening* along a continuation where nothing admitted is lost and something keeps being opened (`Web.KeepsWidening`)"
notions.says: IncludesAcrossFrom R l T and KeepsOpening R l T: from T on nothing admitted is lost across any stretch, and after every step something is admitted that continues nothing admitted there.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensWithLag
notions.grain: whole run, with some lag in steps
notions.quote: 07 section 2, r-comparing-two-courses-on-what-they-admit: "*widens it with a lag* where it includes it with some lag and the other includes it with none (`Web.WidensWithLag`)"
notions.says: IncludesWithLag l l' and not IncludesWithLag l' l.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensOrWithLag
notions.grain: whole run (a join of two listed notions)
notions.quote: docstring ComparingCourses.lean:118: "Widening, or widening with a lag."
notions.says: W.Widens l l' or W.WidensWithLag l l'.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensOrWithFormationLag
notions.grain: whole run, lag varying with the formation
notions.quote: docstring ComparingCourses.lean:296: "Widening, or the strict part of inclusion with a lag varying with the formation."
notions.says: W.Widens l l', or IncludesWithFormationLag l l' without the converse.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensOrEachLater
notions.grain: whole run, a lag for each admission
notions.quote: docstring ComparingCourses.lean:300: "Widening, or the strict part of inclusion with a lag for each admission."
notions.says: W.Widens l l', or IncludesEachLater l l' without the converse.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.WidensOrWithLagAlong
notions.grain: whole run, lag along a continuation R
notions.quote: docstring ComparingCourses.lean:436: "Widening, or the strict part of inclusion with some lag along `R`."
notions.says: W.Widens l l', or inclusion later along R with some lag without the converse.

notions.name: Becoming.Run.RangeWidens
notions.grain: two courses of any process, offset for offset from their starts, over the whole courses
notions.quote: docstring ReachableRanges.lean:214: "Range widening of courses: including and exceeding."
notions.says: r.RangeIncludes adm r' and r.RangeExceeds adm r'.

notions.name: Becoming.Reaching.Widens
notions.grain: of two configurations, over all courses from each (what can be reached)
notions.quote: 07 section 2, r-what-a-course-keeps-reachable: "*widens what can be reached* over it where it covers it and some course from it is included by no course from the other (`Reaching.Widens`)"
notions.says: Covers P adm s s', and some course from s is range-included by no course from s'.

notions.name: Becoming.Reaching.WidensWithLag
notions.grain: of two configurations, over families of courses, with some lag
notions.quote: docstring ReachableRanges.lean:841: "**Widening what can be reached with a lag**: covering with some lag and covered back with none"
notions.says: Some d with CoversLater d s s', and no d with CoversLater d s' s.

notions.name: Becoming.Reaching.WidensOrLater
notions.grain: of two configurations (a join of two listed notions)
notions.quote: docstring ReachableRanges.lean:846: "**The lagged order**: widening what can be reached, or widening it with a lag"
notions.says: Read from its docstring and the chapter only (the body below line 851 was not opened): Reaching.Widens or Reaching.WidensWithLag.

notions.name: Becoming.Reaching.KeepsWidening
notions.grain: one chain of predicates over the steps, read from its first step on
notions.quote: docstring ReachableRanges.lean:307: "**Keeping widening**, 07's form for a chain of predicates: nothing held is lost from a step to any later one, and after every step something not held there is held later"
notions.says: For all n d x, Q n x gives Q (n+d) x, and for every n some later step holds an x not held at n.

notions.name: Becoming.Steps.KeepsWideningFrom
notions.grain: one chain of predicates on a course's moments, from a moment N on
notions.quote: docstring WideningOnTheMap.lean:96: "**Keeping widening from `N`**, 07's form for a chain of predicates"; 07 section 2, r-keeping-widening-is-generation-losing-nothing: "keeping widening from a moment"
notions.says: From N on Steps.includes Q holds across every stretch, and after every step S some later U holds an x not held at S.

notions.name: Becoming.Weighting.WidensOn
notions.grain: on a finite list of items, two Boolean admissions, no steps
notions.quote: docstring Weightings.lean:435: "On the listed items, `a` widens `b`: it admits every item `b` admits, and one more."
notions.says: IncludesOn items a b and ExceedsOn items a b.

notions.name: Becoming.Weighting.WidensBy
notions.grain: on a finite list, by one listed item alone
notions.quote: docstring Weightings.lean:681: "On the listed items `a` widens `b` by `x` alone"
notions.says: IncludesOn items a b, x listed, a admits x and b does not, and (last conjunct, cut off at line 686, read from the docstring) nothing else beyond b.

notions.name: Becoming.Weighting.WidensByOne
notions.grain: on a finite list, by some one item; a relation of the grammar on admissions
notions.quote: docstring PremiseWitnesses.lean:189: "One widening by one listed item alone: `a` widens `b` by some `x` alone."
notions.says: There is an x with WidensBy items x a b.

notions.name: Becoming.Web.Widens
notions.grain: the same definition with its two level paths exchanged; of a part: the levels without it widen the levels with it
notions.quote: module account Regions.lean:37-38: "A part is generative where the levels with it widen those without it, degenerative where those without it widen those with it"; module account Admission.lean:69: "it *narrows*, the converse"; Retaining.lean:348: "does not narrow: the levels without it do not widen those with it"
notions.says: Narrowing is stated as W.Widens l W.level, l the levels without the part: the same Includes-and-Exceeds with the arguments the other way round; no declaration of its own was found for it.

Not read: the module accounts of EventualWidening, KeepingWidening, EventualWideningInstances, ComparingCourses, ReachableRanges, HeldPossible, WideningOnTheMap, Growth, ContinuedClasses, Weightings, CausalGrowth, Tasks, Direction, Retaining (only grep lines), Attraction (only lines 245-262); the bodies of every name marked "not opened" among carriers and refused; all witness namespaces (KindRelay, Ladder, OpeningChain, ClosedCycle, OwnCondition, LagWitness, MergedWitness, Saturated, Loosening, Source, OwnDrawing, Steps.moving and its neighbours), taken as built examples from their names and the chapter's witness lists; the rest of Space.lean after line 60; the three modules beside the package (GenerativeCore, RelationalRenewal, InquirySufficiency: the table has 84 rows from them, none with widen or narrow in its name, and none was opened); the records under results/records; the direction page; FROZEN.md (not opened, as told). The table was searched by name only: a non-theorem declaration that states widening or narrowing under a name without "widen", "narrow", 广, Includes, Exceeds, Covers, Possible, Keeps, Mixed, Closes, Opens or Lexical would not have been found. No Lean, build or test was run; no file was written.
notes:
1. NARROWING has no declaration of its own, in what was searched. The table's grep for "narrow" (case-insensitive) returned no definition of narrowing what can form; the names it returned are a learning module (Becoming.Narrowing, NarrowingRuns), built examples, and a class of readings. Narrowing is said by the one definition Becoming.Web.Widens with its two paths exchanged (Regions.lean:37-38, Admission.lean:69 "it *narrows*, the converse", Retaining.lean:348). So the two sides of P2 are one notion read in two directions: a script that looks for theorems naming notions of two sides will find no P2 pair by names alone, since Web.Widens is on both lists. Which side a statement is on is in the order of the arguments (levels without the part first = narrowing: `W.Widens l W.level`, Retaining.lean:351).
2. Some narrowing statements do not name Web.Widens at all: Clearing.narrows (Clearing.lean:262-263) is stated as `web.Includes l web.level ∧ web.Exceeds l web.level`, the two halves unfolded. A script keyed on Widens misses it; one keyed on Includes and Exceeds would need to read the argument order. Tasks.lean:935-938 (Catalysis.narrows, "narrows the whole possible strictly") is said by its docstring of Reaching.Possible; its statement was not opened.
3. No "keeps narrowing", "eventually narrows" or narrowing-with-lag notion was found in the table grep; the long-run and lagged forms exist on the widening side only, and of them the keeping forms (Web.KeepsWidening, Reaching.KeepsWidening, Steps.KeepsWideningFrom) are about ONE course, not a comparison of two, so they have no converse reading as narrowing. A course that loses without end has, in what was read, no named notion (the nearest is the heading "The future narrows" in Attraction.lean:245, with theorems on Law.Reachable under it, not opened beyond 18 lines).
4. Notions that the chapter says are one, joined by theorems I did not open: Web.Widens and «广» at what the paths admit (`Web.widens_iff`, Regions.lean account line 43); Web.KeepsWidening by name and Reaching.KeepsWidening (`Web.keepsWidening_iff_chain`); Steps.KeepsWideningFrom and Reaching.KeepsWidening shifted (`Steps.keepsWideningFrom_iff_shift`); WidensAlong along the identity and Widens (chapter line 93). The WidensOr* names are joins of a listed notion with a lagged or late one; they were listed because their docstrings say "Widening, or ...", and a later reader may prefer to treat them as orders rather than as the side.
5. Grain: widening is stated at eight grains in what was read (whole run of two level paths; within a region; along a reading between webs; across a stretch of one path; late tails; up to a step; two courses of any process; two configurations over all their courses; a finite listing with no steps; the grammar with no steps), narrowing only at the first, by reversal.
6.
